name: Beirut Restaurant
description: Relaxed outpost offering a traditional Lebanese menu in a modest, diner-like setting.

An absolutely unique and delightful experience at **Beirut Restaurant, Doha!** 🇱🇧

The traditional Arabic hummus was truly exceptional — authentic in taste, rich in flavour, and beautifully presented. Every bite reflected the richness of Lebanese culinary traditions.

A wonderful experience for anyone who appreciates authentic Middle Eastern cuisine. Highly recommended! ❤️

Horrible Food and Disgusting Customer Service

We visited Beirut Restaurant as a family and ordered two or three dishes, including the mutton fatayer. The mutton in the fatayer appeared undercooked, almost raw, and one bite made me feel sick.

We raised the issue with the staff, but they were rude and unhelpful. They refused to refund us, charged us for the dish, and packed it for takeaway despite our complaint. When I said I would share our experience in a review, a staff member replied, “Do whatever you want.”

We left disappointed by both the food and the way our concern was handled. Based on this visit, I would not recommend the restaurant. I’ve attached photos of the food, bill, and restaurant for reference.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A VEGETARIAN’S LITTLE SLICE OF HEAVEN! 🌱🇱🇧

Beirut Restaurant Doha is absolutely fantastic! If you’re vegetarian, this place deserves to be on your must-visit list. 🌱❤️

The hummus is absolutely delicious — creamy, fresh, full of flavour and honestly hard to stop eating! 🤤 And the foul is incredible — rich, hearty, perfectly seasoned and packed with authentic flavour. You can tell the food is made with care and quality ingredients.

There’s a great selection of vegetarian dishes, so you’re definitely not left sitting there with a boring salad while everyone else enjoys themselves! 😂🌱

The flavours are authentic, portions are generous, and everything we tried was simply delicious.

If you love Lebanese food and you’re vegetarian, Beirut Restaurant Doha is definitely worth a visit. The hummus and foul alone are enough to bring me back! 😍

Absolutely delicious — 10/10! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We ordered the meat fatteh with yogurt, hummus topped with meat, and two Pepsi drinks. Overall, the food was tasty and well-prepared. I would rate the meat fatteh 4/5 and the hummus with meat 4/5.

The main downside was the pricing, as we felt it was somewhat expensive considering the portions and overall experience. The total bill came to QAR 97 for two people, which felt a little high.

Overall, it was a good dining experience, but I believe the prices could be more reasonable.
